# Chapter 7: The Dirtiest Job

It had rained the night before, just a light rain, the kind that left the air smelling fresh and made the pavement slick but didn't suggest any serious weather event. By morning, the rain had stopped, and the sun had come out, and the world looked ordinary in the way that mornings usually looked ordinary—which was why what happened next seemed so inexplicable.

All the business computer systems stopped working.

Bob was in the data center when the first alerts came
